name: Golden Egg (CR 8)
body:
Golden Egg
CR 8

XP 4,800

Type magical; Perception automatic, or DC 20 if hidden; Disable Device DC 30

EFFECTS

Trigger proximity (15 feet); Reset none; Bypass Stealth DC 30

Effect spell effect (fireball, 5d6 fire damage, DC 14 Reflex half; some golden eggs instead inflict acid, cold, or electricity damage); multiple targets (all targets in a 20-ft. burst)
